content_zh:
第十五章 寂寞如雪的瑞雯
感谢【情情情情情丶】打赏，O(∩_∩)O~~
听着苏环的话，‘不想再跪了’心里一阵疑惑。
要知道瑞雯已经是七个人头在身，击杀了豹女之后，就直接超神了。
这是一种荣耀，并不是很常见，所以很少会有人把超神的人头让出，有得甚至因为你抢了他的头，而对你大骂特骂。
而且瑞雯杀人剑在身，虽说助攻同样可以得到一层次，但是杀一个人却是增加两层，所以‘不想再跪了’很是不解。
“瑞雯大神，你出了杀人剑，豹女的人头你收了吧。而且你再杀一个就超神了！”想了想‘赢了吃键盘’还是拒绝了拿这个人头。
“没关系，杀人剑助攻也是可以叠起的，而且人头总不能我一个人全拿了吧，我现在装备经济已经领先很多了，自然人头该让的要让，要不然后面打团的话，对面针对我，你们怎么办？”
苏环听闻，淡淡笑道，对发条却是增加了点好感，当然苏环现在并不知道潘森已经挂机了，如果知道的话，这个人头他估计是不会让的。
如果豹女知道自己这个人头，对方正在谦让，推来推去的话，估计都要一口血喷涌而出，死不瞑目了。
‘不想再跪了’一听，更是觉得瑞雯大神深谋远虑，想了一想觉得有道理，随后就不再客气，直接一记普攻带走豹女。
“玩家‘不想再跪了’击杀了‘妹控赛高’”
看着豹女的ID，苏环一阵汗颜，估计又是一个死宅。
“呵呵，还想杀人家瑞雯，这就被人抓死了。”呆在泉水的潘森一看，笑着嘲讽道。
豹女一听，脸色怒气一闪而过，但是他并没有说什么。
自己确实是非常大意了，也有些抱着侥幸心理了。以为对方会去拿小龙，却是没有想到自己的心里有些被摸透，直接被蹲。
现在这种局势要怎么打，想着自己这把是晋级赛，豹女心中非常不甘。
但是他却没有任何办法。
击杀了豹女之后，已经没有人可以阻止蓝色方拿下小龙了。
时间来到游戏九分钟，蓝色方拿下了第一条小龙。

打完小龙后，苏环看见发条就想原地回城。
“别走，把对面的蓝BUFF给拿了先。”
‘不想再跪了’闻言一愣，随后反应过来。跟着苏环来到紫色方蓝BUFF处，发现竟然真的有蓝BUFF！！
‘不想再跪了’瞬间又是一阵膜拜，要知道从游戏开始到现在，野区根本就没有视野，一片漆黑。
所以他根本不知道BUFF的刷新时间。
“瑞雯大神，你怎么知道对方的蓝BUFF刷新了!？”‘不想再跪了’忍不住心中疑惑，开口问道。
“很简单，对面盲僧先是打完我们红BUFF，也就是说七分钟的时候我们自家红BUFF就又会刷新出来。”
“而前面盲僧抓过你一次的时候，身上是有双BUFF的。”
“在一级的时候，你也看到对面入侵了我们的野区，那么对面就是先红，再蓝。”
“我们自家红BUFF刷新之后，和对面蓝BUFF的刷新时间也就相差不到一分多钟。”
苏环一边打着蓝BUFF，一边说着。
“这个蓝BUFF先给我，下个给你。”随后看到蓝BUFF死血的时候，突然说道。
见瑞雯收下蓝BUFF之后，‘不想再跪了’又是按下回城键回城。
苏环一看心中无奈，看来低分段的意识普遍不是很好。
先前他看了看面板，豹女复活时间还没到，伊泽瑞尔和琴女已经出现在下路了，只有一个盲僧不知道在哪，不过苏环也不在意。
“别回去，把中路塔给拆了先。”看着回城的发条，苏环提示道。
‘不想再跪了’一听顿时泪流满面，想回一个城怎么那么难。
而且，瑞雯大神你节奏太快了好吗，我完全跟不上啊。
当然虽然这么想，但是他也是瞬间停止回城，跟着苏环跑到中路，推线推塔。
期间盲僧看到，还想跑来守塔，不过被苏环再塔下两段‘折翼之舞’一打，瞬间吓得退回二塔。

而且盲僧也发现瑞雯脚下的蓝BUFF，至于怎么来的，已经不用去猜了。
…………
游戏时间来到十分钟出头，紫色方上中两路各自被拆了一塔。
回家出完装备后，瑞雯直接朝着上路走去，中间顺便帮发条拿了自家的蓝BUFF。
“怎么回事，好久没看到潘森了。”看着一大波兵线，苏环心中一阵疑惑。
随后苏环在所有人的频道内打字。
“潘森呢，怎么不见了。”
看到瑞雯的疑问，紫色方一众都有些无奈，知道潘森挂机的事情，肯定瞒不住，索性说了出来。
“瑞雯大神，潘森直接被你打成煞笔了，挂机去了。”
“大神脚下留情啊，这才十分钟出头，两座塔就被你给拆了，还能玩吗。”
“瑞雯大神，你要是把装备全卖了，出去发果照你。”
“大神，这一把咱好好玩，玩个一小时吧。”
…………
一瞬间好几条信息涌现，苏环一阵大汗，却是没想到潘森竟然直接挂机了。
而袁世凯也是看见这些信息，转过头来，竖起大拇指。
“吊！”
“大神出去求加好友，求带双排，求飞啊。”发条看到对面潘森直接被打挂机了，心里一阵震动不可置信中，随后非常激动道。
袁世凯看到，咧嘴笑道。
“滚粗，瑞文大神正在和我双排呢！”
“草，又尼玛输在起跑线上。”发条一阵泪流，他发现这些大神练小号，基本上都是来带朋友或同学双排的。

想求带，可谓难于上青天。
“对面的给中推吗？”苏环有些想快点结束这一把了，既然潘森都挂机了，本来5V3都有些艰难了，现在4V3的状态下凭借着现在紫色方的发育情况来看，已经无法阻止自己了。
现在苏环的装备是：杀人剑、残暴之力、暴风之剑、吸血鬼节杖、草鞋。
是的，十分钟出头，苏环的装备已经让紫色方众人恐惧，基本上现在只要遇到紫色方的人，大招都不用开启，就可以直接一套带走。
就算四人一起来抓，他都不惧。
而且苏环的杀人剑已经九层了，亦是为其增加了大量攻击力。
看到瑞雯的话，紫色方一众非常憋屈，心中愤怒，都下定决心不投降。
“大神别逗，咱慢慢玩不行吗？”
“瑞雯大神，求放过上路。”
“大神，请容我再说一句，卖了装备，发果照哦。”
…………
好吧，看样子都很不服输，既然这样的话，那就别怪我不客气了。
随后苏环也不说话，直接把兵线飞快的推进。
他决定了，直接把上路的水晶给直接推了。
当然要是对面敢来抓他，他不介意让对面的知道什么叫势不可挡，什么叫无解状态下的瑞雯。
顺便，自己队友也可以趁那个时候速度推塔。
content_en:
Chapter 15 Ruiwen is as lonely as snow
Thanks to [情情情情情丶] for the reward, O(∩_∩)O~~
Listening to Su Huan's words, "I don't want to kneel anymore," I felt confused.
You must know that Ruiwen already has seven heads in her body. After killing the Leopard Girl, she became a super god.
This is an honor, but not very common, so it is rare for someone to give up the head of a super god, and some may even curse you because you took his head.
Moreover, Ruiwen carries the murderous sword. Although assists can also gain one level, killing a person increases two levels, so "I don't want to kneel anymore" is very puzzled.
"Master Ruiwen, you have released the murderous sword. You can take the head of the leopard girl. And if you kill one more, you will be awesome!" After thinking about 'win and get the keyboard', he still refused to take the head.
"It doesn't matter, the assists of the Killing Sword can also be stacked, and I can't take all the heads by myself, right? I'm much ahead in equipment economy now, so naturally I have to give up the heads. Otherwise, if we fight in a group from behind and the opponent targets me, what will you do?"
When Su Huan heard this, he smiled lightly and felt a little better about Chongzhang. Of course, Su Huan didn't know that Pan Sen had hung up now. If he had known, he probably wouldn't have let the head go.
If the Leopard Girl knew that the other party was giving way to her and pushing her around, she would probably have a mouthful of blood gushing out, and she would die with her eyes open.
When I heard "I don't want to kneel anymore", I felt that the great god Riwen was far-sighted. After thinking about it, I felt it made sense. Then I stopped being polite and took away the Leopard Girl with a basic attack.
“The player ‘doesn’t want to kneel anymore’ and kills the ‘sister control Sai Gao’”
Looking at Leopard Girl's ID, Su Huan felt ashamed. He was probably another deadbeat.
"Haha, I wanted to kill Ruiwen, but I was caught and died." Pan Sen, who was staying in the spring, took a look and laughed and mocked.
When Leopard Girl heard this, anger flashed across her face, but he didn't say anything.
I was indeed very careless, and I was also taking a chance. I thought that the other party was going to get Xiaolong, but I didn't expect that my heart was being penetrated and I was squatted directly.
How to fight this situation now? Thinking that this is a promotion match, Leopard Girl is very unwilling.
But there was nothing he could do.
After killing Leopard Girl, no one can stop the blue side from taking down the dragon.
The time came to nine minutes of the game, and the blue side took the first dragon.
After beating Xiaolong, Su Huan wanted to go back to the city when he saw Clockwork.
"Don't leave, take the blue buff on the opposite side first."
"I don't want to kneel anymore." Hearing this, he was stunned for a moment, and then he came to his senses. Following Su Huan to the purple square blue BUFF, I found that there was actually a blue BUFF! !
"I don't want to kneel anymore" was an instant of worship. You must know that from the beginning of the game to now, the jungle area has no vision at all and it is pitch black.
So he doesn't know the refresh time of BUFF at all.
"Master Ruiwen, how do you know that the other party's blue buff has been refreshed!?" 'I don't want to kneel anymore' couldn't help but be confused and asked.
"It's very simple. The blind monk on the opposite side will finish our red BUFF first, which means that our own red BUFF will be refreshed in seven minutes."
"And when the blind monk caught you once before, you had double BUFFs on your body."
"At level one, you also saw that the opponent invaded our wild area, so the opponent would be red first, then blue."
"After our own red BUFF is refreshed, the refresh time of our opponent's blue BUFF is less than one minute."
Su Huan said while using the blue buff.
"Give me this blue BUFF first, and give you the next one." Then he suddenly said when he saw the blue BUFF dying.
After seeing Ruiwen accept the blue BUFF, "I don't want to kneel anymore" and pressed the return button to return to the city.
Su Huan looked at her heartUnfortunately, it seems that the consciousness of low-level people is generally not very good.
He looked at the panel earlier. It was not yet time for Leopard Girl to resurrect. Ezreal and Qin Girl had already appeared in the bottom lane. There was only one blind monk who didn't know where he was, but Su Huan didn't care.
"Don't go back, demolish the middle tower first." Su Huan reminded as he looked at the clockwork for returning to the city.
When I heard "I don't want to kneel anymore," I burst into tears, wondering why it was so difficult to go back to a city.
Moreover, Master Riwen, your pace is too fast, okay? I can’t keep up at all.
Of course, even though he thought so, he immediately stopped returning to the city and followed Su Huan to the middle, pushing lanes and towers.
During this period, the blind monk saw it and wanted to run to guard the tower. However, Su Huan hit him with two "Dance of Broken Wings" below the tower, and he was instantly frightened and retreated back to the second tower.
Moreover, the blind monk also discovered the blue BUFF at Ruiwen's feet. As for where it came from, there is no need to guess.
…………
The game time came to just over ten minutes, and one tower was demolished on both sides of the purple side.
After returning home and getting her equipment, Ruiwen walked directly to the top road, and helped Clockwork get her own blue BUFF along the way.
"What's going on? I haven't seen Pan Sen for a long time." Looking at the large wave of soldiers, Su Huan felt confused.
Su Huan then typed in everyone's channel.
"Where's Pan Sen? Why is he missing?"
Seeing Ruiwen's question, everyone on the purple side was a little helpless. Knowing that Pan Sen was hanging up, they definitely couldn't hide it, so they simply spoke out.
"Master Ruiwen, Pan Sen was beaten to a pulp by you and hung up."
"God, please be merciful. It's only been ten minutes and you've demolished two towers. Can we still play?"
"Master Ruiwen, if you sell all your equipment, I will go out and make some fruit for you."
"Master, let's have fun with this game. Let's play for an hour."
…………
Several messages came out in an instant, and Su Huan was sweating profusely, but he didn't expect Pan Sen to hang up directly.
When Yuan Shikai saw this information, he turned his head and gave a thumbs up.
"Hang!"
"Master, please go out and ask for friends, bring a duo, and fly." Chongzhang saw that Pan Sen on the opposite side was directly AFKed, and his heart was shaken in disbelief, and then he said very excitedly.
Yuan Shikai saw it and grinned.
"Get out of here, Lord Raven is playing double queue with me!"
"Damn it, I lost at the starting line again." Chongzhong burst into tears. He found that these masters practicing trumpet basically came to lead their friends or classmates in double row.
It can be said that it is difficult to reach the sky if you want to ask for guidance.
"Do you want to push the one on the other side?" Su Huan wanted to end this game quickly. Now that Pan Sen has hung up, 5V3 was already a bit difficult. Now in the 4V3 state, judging from the current development of the purple side, he can no longer stop himself.
Su Huan's equipment now is: Killing Sword, Brutal Power, Storm Sword, Vampire Scepter, and Straw Sandals.
Yes, in just over ten minutes, Su Huan's equipment has already frightened everyone on the purple side. Basically, whenever you meet someone on the purple side, you don't need to activate the ultimate move, you can just take it away in one set.
Even if four people come to arrest him together, he is not afraid.
Moreover, Su Huan's murderous sword has reached the ninth level, which also increases its attack power a lot.
Seeing Ruiwen's words, the purple party was very aggrieved and angry, and they were determined not to surrender.
"Master, don't be ridiculous, can't we just take our time and play with it?"
"Great God Ruiwen, please let me go."
"Master, please allow me to say one more thing, sell the equipment and take photos of the results."
…………
Well, they all seem to be unwilling to admit defeat. If that's the case, don't blame me for being rude.
Then Su Huan didn't say anything and quickly advanced his troops.
He decided and pushed the crystal on the road directly.
Of course, if the opponent dares to catch him, he doesn't mind letting the opponent know what it means to be unstoppable and what it means to be in a state of no solution to Raven.
By the way, my teammates alsoYou can take advantage of that time to push the tower quickly.
